scenario_summary: Customer is reporting an unrecognized transaction of $76 and seeking clarification or a potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Julio Perez and I'm 80. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Mr. Perez, I'm sorry to hear you're concerned about an unrecognized charge. I would be happy to look into this for you. To ensure your account security, could you please provide your full account number and verify your billing zip code?
My account number is 8829-1029-4402 and my zip code is 90210.

Thank you, Mr. Perez. I have successfully verified your account. I am looking at your transaction history now. I see a charge for $76.00 from 'Global Merchant Services' dated two days ago. Does that name sound familiar at all?
No, that doesn't ring a bell. I don't do much shopping online, and certainly not with a company by that name.

I understand. Under our Fraud Protection Policy, if a transaction is deemed unauthorized, we initiate a formal dispute to recover those funds. I have checked the merchant details, and since this is an unrecognized charge, I have initiated a dispute case for you. Your case number is #9928374.
Oh, that's a relief. Does this mean I get my money back now?

Per our standard policy for first-time reported unauthorized charges, I have issued a provisional credit of $76.00 to your account immediately while the investigation concludes. You should see this reflected in your balance within 24 hours.

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's identity, confirmed the unrecognized nature of the charge, and issued a provisional credit while opening a formal dispute case.

judge_scores.justification: The agent conducted appropriate security verification, maintained a warm and empathetic tone tailored to the customer's stated age and concern, and efficiently resolved the issue without redundant steps. Furthermore, the agent took concrete action by opening a formal dispute case and issuing a provisional credit while correctly citing company policy.
